See the measure documentation (Central Hydronic GHP, Packaged GHP, Console GHP) for the Comprehensive GHP + High Efficiency Envelope package for a detailed discussion on the savings by end use. Lighting energy is the main end use contributing to the additional savings in the Comprehensive GHP + High Efficiency Envelope + LED Lighting package. The reduced lighting load is also contributing to changes in HVAC end uses. The package with LED Lighting sees additional cooling and fan savings because the more efficient lights emit lower internal gains to the building during hotter months, hence reducing the cooling and fan load required. For the same reason, the lower internal gains from the LED Lighting are resulting in higher heating loads required during winter (when internal gains are advantageous). Altogether, the cooling and fan savings outweigh the heating penalty, indicating that LED Lighting does save HVAC energy at the stock level. 5.3 Stock Utility Bill Impact This section includes a comparison of national-level annual utility bills of the stock across different fuel sources (i.e., electricity, natural gas, propane, fuel oil). ComStock uses utility region mapping to determine all associated electricity rates that can be used by a building in that region. Therefore, the results can include many annual utility rates per building. The comparison in this section highlights three statistics (i.e., maximum, mean, and minimum) across all possible electric utility rates in a given location.
